title: Deadly College Murders
tagline: Trust no one. Decode everything. Run, if you still can.
award: International Impact Book Awards — Outstanding Literary Achievement (August 2026)
blurb: Hannah Walker didn’t come to college to fear for her life—she came to chase a dream: solving the kinds of mysteries only the brilliant minds conquer. Majoring in Administration of Justice, she always idolized Sherlock Holmes. But when her disturbingly eccentric writing professor is found gruesomely murdered, her dream curdles into a nightmare.
Then the killings escalate.

One by one, faculty members are slaughtered in a string of murders laced with cryptic riddles, twisted symbols, and chilling clues. With the entire campus drowning in paranoia, Hannah turns to her godfather Rafael—a man with secrets of his own. Together, they must unravel a deadly puzzle before the killer turns the game on them.
Because in this college, the final exam is survival. And Hannah’s next assignment might just be her last...
Deadly College Murders: Trust no one. Decode everything. Run, if you still can.
characters: Hannah Walker

A student majoring in criminal justice who has always aspired to be like Sherlock Holmes. When her writing professor is murdered, she wants to solve the case. But when faculty members are murdered one by one, it is up to Hannah and her godfather Rafael to solve the case before they become victims in Deadly College Murders.
Rafael Walker-Smith

Rafael is a former cop and Hannah’s godfather. Devoted to his goddaughter, he is the one who will be there for Hannah when everyone else betrays her. As she suffers a personal tragedy, Rafael will do his best to ensure her safety, going as far as placing her in witness protection. As the bodies drop and her dreams continue to disturb her, Rafael will be the one to help her solve the case before he becomes a victim himself.
Professor Gonzalez

Meet Professor Gonzalez, a writing professor whom Hannah despises. When we meet him, we discover he has harassed her and threatened her not to go to the campus police. He is married, but he has disturbing secrets that continue to unfold even after his death. After he is murdered, Hannah is accused of his death, and it will be up to her to bring him justice.
Daniel Jimenez

Daniel is Hannah’s best friend. She has been in love with him for several years, but he doesn’t feel the same. When Hannah is accused, it will be up to him and Rafael to uncover the mystery. He is majoring in Astronomy. Will he and Hannah end up together once the mystery is solved?
Robert Garcia
Robert is a widower with whom Hannah has an affair. He is a charming man with a dark past. When Hannah is framed for the Deadly College Murders, he is there for her… until he betrays her.
Sofia Johnson

Sofia is Hannah’s best friend, a lawyer from New York who moved to be with Hannah after getting a job offer. When Hannah is accused of the Deadly College Murders, Sofia starts showing her dark side. Will she betray Hannah?

title: Deadly Vows
subtitle: Echoes of College Crimes
tagline: “What begins with love... ends with silence.”
blurb: Hannah Walker swore she left the darkness of college behind. But when she returns to her hometown for her best friend Connie’s wedding, an eerie sense of déjà vu creeps in. Whispers from the past echo louder, and the nightmare begins anew.
Connie is found dead mere hours before her vows.

Beside her body lies a chilling riddle—eerily similar to those Hannah once unraveled in a string of college killings. But this time, the game is different. The riddles aren’t just clues—they’re personal. Someone knows Hannah. Someone knows her secrets.

As the investigation twists through hidden letters, corrupted memories, and figures from Hannah’s past who were thought long gone, she and Rafael must stay ahead of a killer who’s not just reliving history... but rewriting it. Every discovery points to something darker buried beneath the town’s polished facade—an old betrayal, a secret pact, and the revival of a legacy drenched in blood.
And what the killer wants now… is closure. “What begins with love... ends with silence.”

Bree will be the one who helps Hannah on her journey when she gets into a serious accident.

title: Paris Noir
subtitle: Deadly Obsession
tagline: Every Clue Leads to Paris. Everybody Is a Message. And He’s Always One Step Ahead.
award: 2025 International Impact Book Awards winner — Mystery/Thriller: Psychological Thrillers
blurb: The bells are ringing in Paris, but for Hannah, they sound like a funeral knell. A wedding day meant for celebration dissolves into a nightmare of blood and twisted metal when a hooded driver strikes down her beloved godfather, Rafael, in a calculated act of violence.

In Paris Noir: Deadly Obsession, the altar becomes a place of shadows rather than light. While Rafael desperately tries to bury the sins of a past that has finally caught up to him, Hannah is consumed by haunting, prophetic dreams—visceral visions of a wedding ceremony that is always cut short, leaving her silenced before she can ever utter the words “I do.”

They are no longer just victims; they are pieces in a sadistic game of cat and mouse. A hooded figure stalks their every move, leaving behind a trail of cryptic riddles that pulse with a mocking, silent laughter. From the rain-slicked streets of Paris to the neon-lit deceptions of Las Vegas, Hannah must navigate a world where nothing is as it seems.

With the help of an enigmatic illusionist who teaches her to see through the veil of lies, Hannah races to unmask the mastermind before the final riddle is solved. In this deadly obsession, the clues are written in malice, and the truth is buried deep in the shadows of a past Rafael never wanted her to find.
Will Hannah finally get to say her vows, or will the hooded figure ensure her silence is permanent? The answers lie in Paris Noir: Deadly Obsession.

teaser.title: A “Deadly Riddle” Teaser
lines: “A vow is a promise, a ring is a chain,
One leads to pleasure, the other to pain.
You wait for the ‘I do’ at the end of the aisle,
But I’ll give you ‘I die’ with a hooded smile.”

title: The Thirteenth Riddle
subtitle: A Poisoned Silence
award: International Impact Book Awards — Outstanding Literary Achievement (August 2026)
blurb: The shadows of Paris were only the beginning. In the wake of a wedding shattered by violence, Detective Hannah Walker has emerged as a woman transformed—hardened, relentless, and no longer playing by the rules. But the ghosts of her past refuse to stay buried.

The nightmare resurfaces when the body of Laura Gonzalez—the woman who sealed Hannah’s fate during the Deadly College Murders—is discovered in a cold apartment. Beside the corpse lies a single, mocking riddle, a jagged fragment of a puzzle Hannah thought she had solved. The game turns lethal when her beloved godfather, Rafael, is kidnapped and injected with a slow-acting toxin. As his life begins to drain away, the trail leads them toward Lucerne and a mysterious figure known only as Dr. Stu.

But as Hannah and Rafael race toward Die Klinik: Den Geist zu Heilen, the battlefield shifts from the physical world to the fractured landscape of Hannah’s mind. She is haunted by a recurring, waking nightmare: a high-speed train cutting through a void, where she sits across from a faceless shadow. Between them sits a porcelain pot of tea—a deceptively calm ritual that hides a deadly reality. In these visions, the steam carries the scent of bitter almonds, and Hannah realizes that the tea she drinks in her dreams is poisoning her in the real world.

In a desperate act of loyalty to save her godfather, Hannah intentionally tethers her fate to his, embracing the toxins as they course through her veins. Now, as both godfather and goddaughter face a poisoned silence, their only hope lies with Tatiana—the enigmatic former illusionist and godmother to Hannah’s daughter, Shayla.

At the clinic where “healing minds” is a mask for erasing them forever, Hannah must navigate a distorted Hallway of Mirrors that threatens to shatter her sanity. If she breaks the glass, she might find the cure; if she fails, the reflection will be the last thing she ever sees.
Will Hannah survive the nightmare to return to her daughter, Shayla? Or will the thirteenth riddle be the last thing she ever hears?
The answers lie in The Thirteenth Riddle: A Poisoned Silence.

teaser.title: The “Dream Tea” Teaser
lines: “Steam rises up from a cup made of bone,
A secret you drink while you’re sitting alone.
The train never stops, though the tracks are all gone,
Drink deep of the silence... you won’t see the dawn.”

title: Who Murdered Erica Ivy
tagline: Some secrets don’t stay buried. Some names should never be forgotten.
blurb: Astrid Fitzgerald did not expect the past to walk back into her case files. A no-nonsense detective shaped by a tragic history, she is pulled off balance when Erica Ivy is murdered—the woman who ruined her life years earlier.

Erica was cold, manipulative, and willing to remove anyone in her way. She and Astrid share a dark, complicated history, and a break-in had already brought them face to face. Now the murder is Astrid’s to solve, and justice is tangled up with everything she has tried to bury.

The only man she trusts is Thomas, the former criminal justice professor who trained her to read people. He keeps her clear-headed as the suspects multiply and every clue points somewhere she would rather not look.
Some secrets don’t stay buried. Some names should never be forgotten.
Who Murdered Erica Ivy: Trust no one. Question everything.
characters: Astrid Fitzgerald

A no-nonsense detective with a steely demeanor, shaped by a painful past that left her guarded. Erica ruined her life years earlier. When Erica Ivy is murdered, Astrid cannot chase the case without confronting that history.
Thomas

Astrid’s former criminal justice professor, and the only man she trusts. He trained her to read people and keeps her clear-headed when the murder pulls her off balance. He worries for her safety, and he asks her not to let Erica’s death consume her.
Erica Ivy

Cold, manipulative, and willing to remove anyone who stands in her way. Her history with Astrid is the wound at the center of the first book, and her murder opens the Astrid Fitzgerald Mystery Series.

title: The Woman in the Evidence
tagline: A fractured mirror, a woman’s reflection, and evidence that someone is hiding the truth.
blurb: The Woman in the Evidence is the second book in the Astrid Fitzgerald Mystery Series. A fractured mirror, a woman’s reflection, and evidence that suggests someone is hiding the truth.
What looks settled in the glass does not match the story around it. The proof starts to split, and Astrid has to decide which reflection is the one she can trust.

title: Someone Lied at Midnight
tagline: A shadow behind interrogation glass, a rain-soaked room, and a secret that refuses to stay buried.
blurb: Someone Lied at Midnight is the third book in the Astrid Fitzgerald Mystery Series. A shadow waits behind interrogation glass, in a rain-soaked room, and a secret refuses to stay buried.
The figure on the other side of the glass has already told a story. Astrid has to find the lie that midnight was supposed to keep.
